fine_lines.title: try vs tried
fine_lines.explanation_ar: try تعني يجرّب (حاضر)، و tried ماضيها: I tried it once (جرّبته مرة).

examples.sentence: I want to try boxing classes.

fine_lines.title: excited vs exciting
fine_lines.explanation_ar: excited تصف شعور الشخص (أنا متحمس)، و exciting تصف الشيء (الحصة مثيرة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Excited = how you feel. Exciting = the thing.

expressions.phrase: I didn't expect to see you here!
expressions.meaning_en: Say you are surprised to meet someone.
expressions.example: Ali! I didn't expect to see you here!

expressions.phrase: I just started coming to this gym.
expressions.meaning_ar: بدأت للتوّ المجيء إلى هذه الصالة.
expressions.example: I just started coming to this library.

expressions.phrase: I come here three times a week.
expressions.meaning_ar: آتي إلى هنا ثلاث مرات في الأسبوع.
expressions.example: I come here twice a week.
What do you do here? I run on the treadmill.

expressions.meaning_en: Say why an activity is good.

expressions.phrase: Sitting too much is not good.

expressions.phrase: Do you want to join a class with me?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تريد أن تنضمّ إلى حصة معي؟
expressions.example: Do you want to join a class with me? That sounds fun!

expressions.phrase: When do you go? — I go on Mondays at 7 PM.
expressions.meaning_ar: متى تذهب؟ — أذهب أيام الاثنين الساعة السابعة مساءً.
expressions.example: When do you go? On Saturdays at 9 a.m.

expressions.phrase: Thanks for being my gym buddy.
expressions.meaning_en: Thank a friend who exercises with you.
expressions.example: Thanks for being my gym buddy, Omar.

grammar.title: Present simple for routines + on Mondays / three times a week
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للعادات مع on + اسم اليوم بالجمع (on Mondays = كل اثنين) و three times a week.
grammar.explanation_en: Present simple for routines. On Mondays = every Monday.
examples: I come here three times a week.
I go on Mondays at 7 PM.

grammar.title: Past simple vs present perfect for experience
grammar.explanation_ar: I tried it once (الماضي البسيط مع وقت أو عدد محدد). I've tried it a few times (المضارع التام لخبرة حتى الآن بلا وقت محدد).
grammar.explanation_en: Past simple: I tried it once. Present perfect: I've tried it a few times (experience, no time given).
examples: I've tried it a few times.
I just started coming to this gym.

grammar.title: want to + verb / helps + with
grammar.explanation_ar: want to + الفعل للرغبة (I want to try boxing). و help with + اسم (It helps with fitness).
grammar.explanation_en: want to + verb; help with + noun.
examples: I want to try boxing classes.
Do you want to join a class with me?
